implementation: Windows Embedded Compact Enhanced Cryptographic Provider (RSAENH)
description: Microsoft Windows Embedded Compact Enhanced Cryptographic Provider (RSAENH), designed for FIPS 140-2 compliance, is a general-purpose, software-based, cryptographic module. It can be dynamically linked into applications by software developers to permit the use of general-purpose cryptography.
